title: bupleurum stellatum var. typicum
intro: Bupleurum stellatum var. typicum, commonly known as Starry Hare's Ear, is a perennial plant species in the carrot family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and depression, and acting as an antiviral agent. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum stellatum var. typicum include its ability to regulate the body's energy and balance the yin-yang principle, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include saikosaponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
